name: dot-skill
description: Control Dot. devices and design Canvas API layouts from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Control Dot. devices and design Canvas layouts.
interface.longDescription: Dot Skill gives Codex focused guidance for Dot. workflows split into two skills: dot-device-openapi for listing devices, checking status, switching content, and sending Text/Image/Canvas API payloads; and dot-canvas-designer for designing Canvas API windowData layouts, styles, list rendering, conditions, and display formatting. API keys are read from the local DOT_API_KEY environment variable and are not stored in the plugin.
defaultPrompt: Send a message to my Dot device.
